name: EPIC 205944548
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 15.6 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 205944548 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.558538 (16th-84th percentiles 15.14191-16.207555), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,428 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.81 solar masses and 15.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,632 K at its surface.
